# Style Altitude

> > Award-winning ski and snowboard publication covering gear reviews, backcountry touring, mountain culture, and sustainable winter sports lifestyle from the French Alps.

Founded by Elaine Deed and based in Serre Chevalier, Style Altitude delivers expert ski and snowboard content spanning technical guides, resort insider tips, pro athlete interviews, and mountain lifestyle features. The site emphasizes ski touring, powder skiing, avalanche safety, and sustainable practices in winter sports.

## Key Topics

- Ski touring and backcountry skiing
- Powder skiing techniques
- Avalanche safety
- Serre Chevalier and French Alps
- Off-piste and freeride
- Sustainable fashion and gear rental
- Mountain lifestyle and tribes
- Ski mountaineering
- La Grave extreme terrain
- Japanese powder destinations
- The North Face and Dynafit gear
- Col du Galibier and Ecrins
- Seasonaire culture
- Custom ski boot fitting
- GoPro mountain filming

## Essential Guides & How-Tos

- [Ski and Snowboard Gear Guide, News & Reviews](https://stylealtitude.com/style): Main ski/snowboard gear hub with reviews, news, and product guides
- [Powder To The People. How to Ski Powder](https://stylealtitude.com/powder-to-the-people.html): Essential guide to skiing powder safely with top 10 technique tips
- [Ski Boot Pain? Insider Customising Tips For Comfortable Ski Boots](https://stylealtitude.com/ski-boot-custom-fit-comfort.html): Louise Hudson's insider guide to custom ski boot fitting and comfort
- [Scared of Skiing? How to Overcome Fear and Anxiety](https://stylealtitude.com/overcoming-skiing-anxiety-fear.html): Louise Pode's coaching tips for overcoming skiing fear and anxiety
- [6 Ways to Improve Your Carving and Skiing Technique](https://stylealtitude.com/how-to-improve-carving-skiing.html): Ken Reeve's CARV app review with 6 carving improvement techniques
- [What Type of Ski Tourer Are You?](https://stylealtitude.com/ski-tour-style-types.html): Guide to 7 ski tourer types from speed tourers to mountaineers
- [GoPro Max 360 skiing & cycling how to film and mount camera](https://stylealtitude.com/gopro-max-360-skiing-how-to-film-and-mount-camera.html): Gavin Baylis' technical guide to filming skiing with GoPro Max 360

## Features & Stories

- [The Award Winning Ski Blog](https://stylealtitude.com/ski-blog): Award-winning daily ski/snowboard updates from Serre Chevalier mountains
- [Ski and Snowboard Features](https://stylealtitude.com/style-altitude-features): Original ski/snowboard features covering Red Bull events to backcountry
- [Views From The Top](https://stylealtitude.com/protalkviews): Pro athlete interviews: Graham Bell, Mathieu Maynadier, Aimee Fuller
- [The Life-Changing Impact Of An Avalanche](https://stylealtitude.com/avalanche-survival-interview-marian.html): Marian Veith's inspirational avalanche survival and recovery story
- [Up Lines. The Joy of Ski Touring](https://stylealtitude.com/uplines.html): Elaine Deed on appreciating the ski touring climb and mountain beauty
- [Die Hard Snowboarder Learning How To Ski in 5 Days](https://stylealtitude.com/snowboarder-learning-to-ski.html): Jes Wootton's 30-year snowboarder transitions to skiing in 5 days
- [THE AXE FACTOR. The Antarctic Ski Experience](https://stylealtitude.com/skiing-the-antarctic.html): Tim Wheeler's Ice Axe Expeditions Antarctic ski touring adventure
